name: hip extension on knees
description: Opens the front of the hips from a kneeling position by pushing the pelvis forward, which also wakes up the glutes.
instructions: Kneel on a soft surface with knees hip-width apart and thighs upright.
Place your hands on your hips or the back of your pelvis.
Squeeze your glutes and push your hips forward.
Keep your ribs down and avoid over-arching your lower back.
Hold for a moment, then return to the start.
